Demo Sound This sets the demonstration sounds that attract customers when the game is not being played.
On With customer attraction sound. Off * Without customer attraction sound.
Difficulty This sets the game difficulty to one of four levels: Easy, Normal*, Difficult and More Difficult.
Factory Setting Push Button 1 and the setting returns to where it was when shipped from the factory. The above items marked with a star (*) denote the factory setting.

Exit To go back to Main Menu, place the cursor here and push Button 1. When the setting of the game has been changed, the machine will ask whether to save the new setting or not. If you want to save the setting you've made, choose "Yes".
